name: Tower
overview: The biblical account of the tower, especially exemplified in the Tower of Babel narrative, reveals humanity's attempt to unify under one language and build a city with a tower reaching to heaven to make a name for themselves and avoid being scattered (Genesis 11:1-4). God observes this endeavor and recognizes the potential for unrestrained human ambition when united in purpose apart from Him (Genesis 11:5-6). This story underscores the futility of human pride and the sovereignty of God in directing human affairs.
